name: Rain & Chamomile Tea
source:
The story of a girl who wakes up in an unfamiliar beachside town after a nightmarish sort of mania. The air is thick with fog and the smell of rot; it almost seems as if something is hiding from her.

[From [url=https://denpa.neocities.org/rain.html]official website[/url]]
